caseName: Shipyard Drive-In Theatre, Inc. v. Scuncio
caseNameFull: Shipyard Drive-In Theatre, Inc. v. Scuncio

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. R. I. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that the judgment should be reversed.
